text:
Two bags each contain only blue balls and red balls.
Bag 1 contains 7 blue balls and 3 red balls.
Bag 2 contains 3 blue balls and 7 red balls.
Maria chooses a ball at random from Bag 1 and puts it into Bag 2.

parts.label: a
parts.text:
Find the probability that the ball chosen is blue.
................................................. [1]

content.html: Find the probability that the ball chosen is blue.
content.text: Find the probability that the ball chosen is blue.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Maria now chooses a ball at random from Bag 2 and puts it into Bag 1.

parts.label: i
parts.text:
Find the probability that both balls chosen are red.
................................................. [2]

content.html: Find the probability that both balls chosen are red.
content.text: Find the probability that both balls chosen are red.

parts.label: ii
parts.text:
Find the probability that one of the balls chosen is red and the other is blue.

parts.label: iii
parts.text:
Find the probability that there are now exactly 7 blue balls in Bag 1.
................................................. [3]
